snapshot.head: 501db6555dae374e5fcf43a6fdcfe8a3dd89343e
snapshot.method: current-source static trace; real 100-agent and real channel fault injection not executed

counting_contract.count_unit: independently reproducible, repairable, rollbackable and acceptable canonical leaf seam

findings.seam: Full child, delegation and workflow result bytes propagate through RuntimeTask, completion outbox and parent continuation context without a result manifest or fan-in byte envelope.
Each child terminal creates a separate global-FIFO continuation wake; there is no parent/run coalescing or tenant fairness.
Async delegation can emit queued and return a handle after durable RuntimeTask creation fails, producing a ghost delegation.
Background subagent child ChatSession commits before RuntimeTask; task creation failure leaves a visible ghost child session.
Durable delegation_chain is not used for cycle rejection; the live guard is process-local and is cleared after the call.
Generic RuntimeTask terminal writes have no monotonic compare-and-set, allowing late completion to overwrite cancel or kill outside the web-chat private guard.
Channel ingress and delivery use global FIFO batches without tenant or channel fairness or reserved interactive headroom.
Agent Team launches members sequentially and can retain a partially started prefix without a complete requested, admitted and deferred ledger.
Fixed workflow fanout, concurrency, leaf, wallclock and token defaults hard-reject preflight without split, defer, checkpoint or model replan.
Workflow fanout creates the whole coroutine/result set and does not return successful leaf coverage as a complete parent outcome when another leaf fails.
Fixed failure and reconciliation thresholds mechanically hard-stop a budget run and cancel pending work without a model recovery lane.
Web-chat root budget creation failure returns None and the run continues without consuming the policy decision that requires work-amplifying tools to be disabled.
Foreground subagent budget approval returns waiting without a durable exact child intent or RuntimeTask that can resume idempotently after approval.
Concurrent parent messages update a RuntimeTask JSON list by read-copy-write and commit without row lock or CAS, permitting lost child completion messages.

known_missing.reason: No complete root-task multi-channel route plan, causal DAG and unified result/delivery ledger was found; this is classified as Missing rather than counted as a breakpoint.

coverage_gaps: Real 100-agent same-second completion and streaming storm not executed.
Real DingTalk, Feishu, Slack and Web credentials and callbacks not fault-injected.
Queue throughput, latency and starvation severity are not quantified with production telemetry.
codebase-memory MCP was unavailable with Transport closed; source tracing used targeted text and file reads.
